goals.title: Decide how `.git/index.lock` should be handled going forward
goals.detail: Standing habit (clear it on a regular cadence regardless of that night's report) vs. treating each recurrence as a fresh surprise.
goals.context: Recurred again overnight (2026-08-11) - 8 of the last 9 nightly overnight-auto-execute runs have hit this same sandbox restriction and had to wait on a manual clear from a real terminal/Claude Code session. Quick decision, but it's now blocking real commits repeatedly.

goals.title: Pick a direction for `Systems Creator` and `Scribbler`
goals.detail: Both are still bare one-liners flagged as genuinely ambiguous - Systems Creator could mean org-systems/frameworks or literal software-architecture help; Scribbler could be notes, creative writing, or overlap with ianlogger/cultureman.
goals.context: Neither is a good one to guess at - both have sat as undeveloped one-liners since the original 2026-07-30 brain-dump. A quick call on direction (even "discard" or "merge into X") unblocks them from just sitting there.

goals.title: Decide `system-healthcheck`'s report format and where it surfaces
goals.detail: Likely feeds dashboard-visualizer and/or the daily-pull digest rather than being its own standalone output - just needs a real pick.
goals.context: Last open, undecided item on system-healthcheck's Sub-projects checklist; the sweep itself is built and running clean nightly, this is purely a presentation decision.
